hero.description: Managed websites, design, and digital ops for small service businesses. Seven shipped products. One human at the core. Each orbit is a problem someone wrote a check to solve.

proof.description: Every engagement ends with a stamped receipt of exactly what we shipped, what it cost, and what it's earning you. No retainers you can't read. No "strategic alignment." Just work and numbers.

services.description: Each number below is a deadline, not a hope. Miss one, get the month free.

items.label: Brand
items.promise: A mark you'll still love in

work.description: Restaurants toss $400/wk in the dumpster. Toast makes you swap your whole POS. This doesn't. Log a loss in 3 taps, get a weekly heatmap.

contact.description: Tell me what's broken. I'll tell you if I can fix it, what it'll cost, and when it'll ship. If not, I'll tell you who can.

playground.description: Four tools I built — working, not mocked. Every one runs entirely in your browser. Screenshots are for websites; these are the real thing.

seo.label: SEO Preview
seo.desc: Paste any URL — see the mock SERP + AI Overview + Core Web Vitals scoring.

pricing.label: Pricing Calculator
pricing.desc: Pick scope, timeline, services, team size — get a live quote you can share.

content.label: Content Generator
content.desc: Give a topic — get a streaming blog outline, tweet thread, newsletter, or script.

design.label: Design System Extractor
design.desc: Paste a URL — extract palette, typography, spacing, and components as Tailwind tokens.
